explication: emoji-translate is a JavaScript library for translating words and sentences into emoji, with a browser-facing API and a Chrome extension that translates page text. The library matches words against emojilib and offers both string and display-element results. The extension separately fetches its bundled emoji data, scans page text, and replaces translatable words. The excerpts establish these runtime paths; the demo page’s implementation was not sampled, so it is not expanded here.
